cover_letter_text:
Hi Subdivisions (Qld) team,

I'm Marc. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. Helping prepare civil design drawings for land subdivisions is exactly what I want to do next.

In the diploma I drew roads, earthworks and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. On site in the Philippines I worked on residential subdivision finishing works, reviewing drawings, checking quality and writing progress reports.

I'd move to the Sunshine Coast and can start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa) and a full Victorian driver's licence. Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
advert_text:
About the Role
We are seeking a talented Graduate Engineer to join our team at Subdivisions (Qld) Pty Ltd in Nambour on the Sunshine Coast. This full-time role will see you playing a crucial part in the delivery of our civil engineering land subdivision projects, using your technical design and knowledge skills to support our growing business.
What you'll be doing
- Assisting with preparation of detailed civil engineering design drawings using 12d and CAD software for urban land subdivision developments including development applications and details for roads, stormwater, water and sewer etc
- Assisting with the development of construction documents, tenders and project specifications
- Liaising with project managers, engineers and other stakeholders
- Providing design and drafting support throughout all stages of project delivery
- Ensuring plans and documents comply with relevant standards, regulations and best practices
What we are looking for
A graduate with demonstrated and proven civil engineering capability ideally with some:
- Proficiency in AutoCAD and 12D
- Excellent attention to detail and ability to work to strict technical specifications
- Good problem solving and analytical skills
- Effective communication
- Enthusiasm for continuous learning and professional development
- A willingness to gain experience with engineering design software including MUSIC, ICM Infoworks, AutoTURN, MS Word and Excel
If you are an engineering student and are yet to graduate, we would also like to hear from you.
What we offer
At Subdivisions (Qld) Pty Ltd, we are committed to providing our employees with a supportive and fulfilling work environment. You'll enjoy a competitive salary, opportunities for career progression and ongoing training and development so that you too can deliver land subdivision developments with great pride.
About us
Subdivisions (Qld) Pty Ltd is a leading provider for civil engineering and land subdivision development services in Queensland. With a strong reputation for delivering high quality subdivision development projects from preliminary concept through to project construction delivery control.  We pride ourselves on our technical expertise, innovative approach and commitment to sustainability. Join our growing team and be a part of shaping the communities of the future.
If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we encourage you to apply now.
